paragraphs: A global communications transformation is underway, and we believe Bandwidth is at the center. Our mission is to develop and deliver the power to communicate. We enable innovative organizations—from startup app developers to the world's largest enterprises—to engage their end-users and deliver exceptional experiences everywhere people live, learn, work, and play. Backed by the Bandwidth Communications Cloud, our global owned-and-operated network spanning more than 65 countries reaching over 90 percent of global gross domestic product ("GDP"), innovative enterprises use Bandwidth's Application Programming Interfaces ("APIs") to easily embed voice, messaging, emergency services, and artificial intelligence ("AI") capabilities into software and applications. Bandwidth was the first cloud communications provider to offer a robust selection of APIs built on our own cloud platform. Our award-winning support teams help businesses around the world transform their communications every day.

Bandwidth is strategically positioned at the intersection of enterprise communications and AI. As global enterprises adopt AI-driven tools to modernize customer experiences, we believe AI voice will become a critical new layer of value creation. Our Maestro™ platform and Communications Cloud are designed to support this evolution, enabling the orchestration of AI voice agents across diverse environments with superior quality, reliability, and scale. We see our emerging leadership in AI Voice as a natural extension of our long-term strategy to power trusted, mission-critical communications for the world's largest enterprises.

Bandwidth's business continues to benefit from the application of AI technologies to cloud communications use cases, the enterprise migration to the cloud, adoption of Contact Center as a Service platforms, the need to be able to work from anywhere, the reinvention of customer experience, and the growth in messaging applications to engage directly with consumers. We believe these market trends are secular, long-lasting, and still early in the adoption curve.

With the combination of our software APIs, our global Communications Cloud, our AI orchestration capabilities, and our broad range of experience with global regulatory frameworks, we believe Bandwidth is one of the best-positioned providers in our space to deliver mission-critical communications for global enterprises. In fact, Bandwidth already powers all the 2025 GartnerⓇ Magic Quadrant Leaders in the key cloud communications categories of Unified Communications as a Service ("UCaaS") and Contact Center as a Service ("CCaaS"), along with leading hyperscalers and Software as a Service ("SaaS") platforms.

We aim to be the key enabling platform for communications transformation in the AI era. We will seek to do this in three ways: (1) cross-sell and up-sell our existing customers as they benefit from our global footprint, powerful APIs, and AI orchestration capabilities to automate and scale cloud communications; (2) focus on direct-to-enterprise growth to serve Global 2000 enterprises that directly leverage Bandwidth services to accelerate their digital transformations; and (3) be the preferred provider for enterprises and SaaS platforms that use conversational voice and messaging to create digital engagements that enhance the customer experience. These three strategies are the foundation of the durable business we seek to build.

We operate in a single reportable segment. Refer to Part II, Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations", and Part II, Item 8, "Financial Statements" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, for a discussion of the results of our operations.

Bandwidth's go-to-market strategy is designed around the global shift from on-premises based technology to cloud-based communications. We believe we are the only Communications Platform as a Service ("CPaaS") provider that also owns and operates a cloud communications network with our global reach. This competitive differentiator has enabled Bandwidth to power the forces behind successive waves of the cloud communications revolution–from the growth of unified communications hyperscalers, to the acceleration of messaging platform leaders, to directly powering global enterprise communications, and now to the adoption of AI voice services. Each of our customer categories uses services on the Bandwidth Communications Cloud in its own unique way, and we have designed three key market offerings to power digital communications transformation.

Through our Global Voice Plans market offering, we power all the leaders in UCaaS and CCaaS, as recognized by the research firm Gartner, including Microsoft, Google, Zoom, Cisco, RingCentral, Genesys, and Five9. We have been co-creating with many of these customers for more than a decade.

These leaders rely on Bandwidth to deliver the voice, messaging, and emergency services that are central to their own user experiences. Our APIs also expedite customer onboarding with real-time global programmable number management (ordering, porting, provisioning) to allow providers to customize their customer journeys, embed our global communications capability into their platforms, and reduce friction to accelerate onboarding. These platforms are global in nature, and they expect a communications partner who can provide direct global coverage and regulatory insight. In many cases, these partners are embedding conversational AI capabilities into their own platforms, and they rely on Bandwidth's Communications Cloud to support those next-generation experiences. We believe our leadership in this market continues to expand with our global footprint and the addition of new capabilities.

We believe Bandwidth's toll-free voice solution is a major reason contact center platforms build with Bandwidth for their North American business. Offering 5x carrier redundancy with available hands-free alternative routing, our own toll-free voice network is combined with four additional directly peered toll-free network partners, offering customers greater peace of mind. Whenever possible, Bandwidth keeps calls on its own network to enable excellent quality and better return on investment. Our four additional peered networks further enable best-in-class coverage as well as resilience—so if one network experiences quality-impacting issues, calls can be routed to a different network seamlessly, before impacts are even felt. Bandwidth's unique Call AssureTM solution provides further redundancy with hands-free alternative routing that is fully insulated from the core network, to protect against an extraordinary disruption, such as a fire, natural disaster or cyberattack.

In this category, Global 2000 enterprises engage directly with Bandwidth to leverage our voice, global number control, emergency services, pre-built integrations with leading UCaaS and CCaaS platforms, easy-to-build call flows, AI voice orchestration, and other services in their digital transformation. Bandwidth provides enterprises a fully or hybrid cloud-based communications solution to transition from their on-premises communications infrastructure to a software-enabled digital environment.

By partnering with Bandwidth, global enterprises can simplify their migrations to the cloud, as well as cloud-to-cloud migrations, while reducing complexity, gaining greater control, centralizing communication resources and operational workloads, adding new AI voice services, and better preparing for future scale. We believe Bandwidth's history as an enabler to the platform leaders creates additional competitive benefits, such as deep automation of communications services, enterprise-grade quality and support, as well as deep operational relationships with the largest UCaaS and CCaaS platforms.

Bandwidth MaestroTM ("Maestro") is a first-of-its-kind, next-generation enterprise cloud communications platform that enables customers to solve the key challenge of integrating best-in-class, real-time voice applications across their UCaaS, CCaaS, AI, and fraud mitigation platforms. We believe Maestro's open approach, designed to integrate technologies developed by third parties, is unique in the cloud communications space. It provides a critical technology bridge and software orchestration layer that enterprises need to build a modern customer experience stack without complex and costly integration, which results in faster time to value, and enhanced customer and employee experiences and loyalty.

Our Maestro platform is key to Bandwidth's AI innovation strategy. We believe it is the most open and flexible solution for enterprises to integrate conversational AI into cloud communications, through Native AI within CCaaS platforms, pre-built partner integrations, Bring Your Own AI with third-party apps, and Public APIs like OpenAI's Realtime interface.

The market in which we participate is highly competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
If we are unable to attract new customers in a cost-effective manner, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.

The market for some of our services is new and unproven, may decline or experience limited growth and is dependent in part on enterprises and developers continuing to adopt our platform and use our services.
Our ability to achieve revenue growth, cashflow, and operating performance depends on retaining customers and increasing their use of our services.
If we are unable to increase the revenue that we derive from enterprises, our business, results of operations and financial condition may be adversely affected.
Our pricing and billing systems are complex, and errors could adversely affect our results of operations.
We must continue to develop effective business support systems to implement customer orders and to provide and bill our customers for services.

If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brand and increase market awareness of our company and services, then our business, results of operations and financial condition may be adversely affected.
We operate internationally, which exposes us to risks that are incremental to those experienced by a company operating only domestically.
A significant portion of our revenue is concentrated in a limited number of large customers.

We are currently subject to litigation related to taxes and charges associated with our provision of 911 services, which could divert management's attention and adversely affect our results of operations.
We are also subject to litigation in the ordinary course of business, and uninsured judgments or a rise in insurance premiums may adversely affect our results of operations.
The communications industry faces significant regulatory uncertainties and the resolution of these uncertainties could harm our business, results of operations and financial condition.
paragraphs: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The risks and uncertainties described below may not be the only ones we face. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline.

Our growth and financial health are impacted by a number of risks, including uncertain capital markets, political and economic instability in a number of regions, the imposition of widespread tariffs, unfavorable macroeconomic conditions, recessionary fears, high rates of inflation and higher interest rates.

In recent years, the financial markets in the United States have experienced substantial volatility in securities prices, reduced liquidity and credit availability, rating downgrades of certain investments and declining values with respect to others. If capital and credit markets continue to experience uncertainty, we may not be able to obtain debt or equity financing or to refinance our existing indebtedness on favorable terms or at all, which could impair our ability to execute on our strategy, and harm our financial performance. These conditions currently have not precluded us from accessing credit markets or financing our operations, but there can be no assurance that financial markets and confidence in major economies will not deteriorate.

In addition, we are vulnerable to changes in market preferences or other market changes, as well as general macroeconomic conditions, reduced growth rates, interest rates, tax rates and policies, inflation, a significant shift in U.S., state and foreign government policies and the deterioration of economic relations between countries or regions, including potential negative consumer sentiment toward non-local products or sources. In recent years, the United States has experienced higher rates of inflation and as a result, we may experience a compression in our gross margins. These inflationary pressures could affect wages, the cost of and our ability to obtain necessary components, the price of our products and services, our ability to meet customer demand, and our gross margins and operating profit. Inflation may further exacerbate other risks discussed in this "Risk Factors" section, such as risks related to our sales and marketing efforts and our ability to attract, motivate and retain sales, engineering and other key personnel. If we are unable to successfully manage the effects of inflation, our business, operating results, cash flows and financial condition may be adversely affected.

As a result of recent changes to U.S. and foreign government policies, there may be changes to existing trade agreements, greater restrictions on free trade generally, the imposition of or significant increases in tariffs on goods imported into the U.S., and adverse responses by foreign governments to U.S. trade policies, among other possible changes. The U.S. government has implemented or announced it intends to implement or increase tariffs, and it remains unclear what the U.S. government or foreign governments will or will not do with respect to tariffs or trade agreements and policies. These trade measures enacted, or threatened to be enacted, by the U.S. and other countries have led to increased volatility and uncertainty in certain parts of the global economy. We cannot predict the timing, strength, or duration of the current or any future potential economic volatility or slowdown in the U.S. or globally. Increased tariffs could adversely impact the costs to us of the fiber, computers, software, transmission electronics and related network components, including network colocation facilities, that are critical to the operation of our network. We may not be able to offset any such increase in costs with a commensurate increase in the price of our services, which could have an adverse impact on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

The U.S. and global economies have in the past, and will in the future, experience recessionary periods and periods of economic instability, which could affect the rate of technology spending generally. During such periods, our existing and potential customers may choose not to expend the amounts that we anticipate based on our expectations with respect to the addressable market for the services we offer. Customers may also suffer financial hardships due to economic conditions such that their accounts become uncollectible or are subject to longer collection cycles. There could also be a number of other effects from adverse general business and economic conditions on our business, including insolvency of any of our third-party suppliers or contractors, decreased market confidence, decreased interest in communications solutions, decreased discretionary spending and reduced customer demand for the services we offer, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations and exacerbate some of the other risk factors contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, total revenue was $754 million, $748 million and $601 million, respectively, representing an increase of 1% in 2025 and an increase of 25% in 2024. Net loss in 2025, 2024, and 2023 was $13 million, $7 million, and $16 million, respectively.

During February 2025, we entered into separate, privately negotiated repurchase agreements with a limited number of holders of the 2026 Convertible Notes (the "2025 Repurchases") to repurchase approximately $27 million aggregate principal amount of the 2026 Convertible Notes for an aggregate cash price of approximately $26 million. The 2025 Repurchases closed on February 24, 2025. Following the 2025 Repurchases and previous repurchases of the 2026 Convertible Notes, approximately $8 million aggregate principal amount of the 2026 Convertible Notes remains outstanding.

The difference between the consideration used for the 2025 Repurchases and the carrying value of the 2026 Convertible Notes resulted in a gain of $1 million recorded within net gain on extinguishment of debt on our consolidated statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025.
We monitor the following key performance indicator to help us evaluate our business, identify trends affecting our business, formulate business plans, and make strategic decisions.

We believe net retention rate is useful in evaluating our business. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, our net retention rate was 98%, 122% and 101%, respectively. Our net retention rate in 2024 benefited from higher volumes of political messaging driven by the U.S. presidential election in November 2024. The lower net retention rate in 2023 and 2025 was primarily driven by lower political messaging revenue following the conclusion of the 2022 and 2024 U.S. election cycles.

Our ability to drive growth and generate incremental revenue depends, in part, on our ability to maintain and grow our relationships with our existing customers that generated revenue and seek to increase their use of our platform. We track our performance in this area by measuring the net retention rate for our customers who generate revenue. To calculate the net retention rate, we first identify the cohort of customers that generated revenue in the same quarter of the prior year. The net retention rate is obtained by dividing the revenue generated from that cohort in a quarter, by the revenue generated from that same cohort in the corresponding quarter in the prior year. The net retention rate reported in a quarter is then obtained by averaging the result from that quarter, by the corresponding results from each of the prior three quarters. Customers of acquired businesses are included in the subsequent year's calendar quarter of acquisition. Our net retention rate increases when such customers increase usage of a product, extend usage of a product to new applications or adopt a new product. Our net retention rate decreases when such customers cease or reduce usage of a product or when we lower prices on our solutions.

As our customers grow their businesses and increase usage of our platform, they sometimes create multiple customer accounts with us for operational or other reasons. As such, when we identify a significant customer organization (defined as a single customer organization generating more than 1% of revenue in a quarterly reporting period) that has created a new customer, this new customer is tied to, and revenue from this new customer is included with, the original customer for the purposes of calculating this metric.

Insights. Bandwidth Insights 給客戶詳細的語音與訊息表現視圖，以協助客戶做出資料驅動的決策，並確保服務品質。
paragraphs: 全球通訊轉型正在進行中，我們認為 Bandwidth 站在中心位置。我們的使命是開發並提供通訊的動力。我們協助創新組織—from 新興應用開發者到全球最大企業—與其終端用戶互動，並在人們居住、學習、工作和娛樂的地方提供卓越的體驗。透過 Bandwidth 通訊雲端，我們的全球自有運營網路橫跨超過 65 個國家，覆蓋全球總體經濟（"GDP"）的 90％以上，創新企業使用 Bandwidth 的應用程式程式設計介面（"APIs"）輕鬆地將語音、訊息、緊急服務和人工智慧（"AI"）功能嵌入軟體和應用程式中。Bandwidth 是第一家在自家雲端平台提供強大 API 選項的雲端通訊供應商。我們的獲獎支持團隊協助全球企業每天轉型其通訊方式。
Bandwidth 策略性地處於企業通訊與 AI 的交點。隨著全球企業採用 AI 驅動工具來現代化客戶體驗，我們認為 AI 語音將成為價值創造的重要新層面。我們的 Maestro™ 平台和通訊雲端是為此演進所設計，能於多樣環境中協調 AI 語音代理，並具備優越的品質、可靠性與規模。我們認為在 AI 語音領域的興起領導地位是我們長期策略的自然延伸，即為全球最大企業提供值得信賴、關鍵任務的通訊。
Bandwidth 的業務持續受益於將 AI 技術應用於雲端通訊用例、企業遷移至雲端、接觸中心即服務平台的採用、能從任何地方工作的需求、客戶體驗的重新定義，以及用於直接與消費者互動的訊息應用程式成長。我們認為這些市場趨勢是長期、持續的，且目前仍處於採用曲線的早期階段。

透過我們的軟體 API、全球通訊雲端、AI 協調能力，以及在全球監管框架方面的廣泛經驗，我們認為 Bandwidth 是我們這個領域中最具優勢的供應商之一，能為全球企業提供關鍵任務通訊。事實上，Bandwidth 已經為 2025 年 GartnerⓇ Magic Quadrant Leaders 提供服務，這些領導者在統一通訊即服務（"UCaaS"）和接觸中心即服務（"CCaaS"）等關鍵雲端通訊類別中，以及領先的超規模雲端供應商和軟體即服務（"SaaS"）平台中。

我們的目標是成為 AI 時代通訊轉型的關鍵啟動平台。我們將透過以下三種方式達成此目標：(1) 向現有客戶跨銷售與升級，因他們能從我們的全球佈局、強大 API 和 AI 協調能力中受益，以自動化和擴展雲端通訊；(2) 聚焦直接對企業成長，服務直接利用 Bandwidth 服務加速其數位轉型的全球 2000 大企業；(3) 成為企業和 SaaS 平台的首選供應商，這些企業和平台使用對話式語音和訊息來創造數位互動，以提升客戶體驗。這三種策略是我們追求建立的永續業務的基礎。
我們經營於單一應報告分部。請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表單的第二部分，第 7 項 "管理層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析"，以及第二部分，第 8 項 "財務報表"，以瞭解我們營運結果的討論。

Bandwidth 的市場策略是圍繞全球從基地端技術轉向雲端通訊的趨勢設計。我們認為我們是唯一同時擁有並運營全球雲端通訊網路的通訊平台即服務（"CPaaS"）供應商。這個競爭優勢使 Bandwidth 能夠驅動雲端通訊革命的連續波動—from 統一通訊超規模雲端供應商的成長，到訊息平台領導者的加速，再到直接驅動全球企業通訊，現在則是 AI 語音服務的採用。我們的每個客戶類別都以獨特的方式使用 Bandwidth 通訊雲端的服務，我們已設計了三個關鍵市場產品來推動數位通訊轉型。
透過我們的全球語音計畫市場產品，我們為 Gartner 承認的 UCaaS 和 CCaaS 領先者提供服務，包括 Microsoft、Google、Zoom、Cisco、RingCentral、Genesys 和 Five9。我們與許多這些客戶合作已超過十年。

這些領導者依賴 Bandwidth 提供語音、訊息及緊急服務，這些服務是他們自身用戶體驗的核心。我們的 API 也加速客戶上線，透過即時全球可程式化號碼管理（訂購、轉號、配置）來允許服務提供者客製化其客戶旅程，將我們的全球通訊能力嵌入其平台，並減少摩擦以加速上線。這些平台具有全球性，他們期待一個能提供直接全球覆蓋及法規見解的通訊夥伴。在許多情況下，這些夥伴會將對話式 AI 能力嵌入其自身平台，並依賴 Bandwidth 的通訊雲端來支援這些下一代體驗。我們相信本公司在這個市場的領導地位會隨著我們的全球足跡及新功能的加入而持續擴張。

我們相信 Bandwidth 的免付費語音解決方案是聯絡中心平台選擇與 Bandwidth 合作以服務其北美業務的主要原因。提供 5 倍電信業者冗餘度及可用的免持話筒替代路由，我們自己的免付費語音網路與四個額外直接對接的免付費網路夥伴結合，為客戶提供更大的安心感。在可能的情況下，Bandwidth 會將通話保留在自己的網路內，以實現優良的品質及更好的投資回報率。我們的四個額外對接網路進一步實現最佳覆蓋及韌性—如果一個網路遭遇影響品質的問題，通話可以無縫地轉移到另一個網路，甚至在影響被感受到之前。
在這個類別中，全球 2000 大企業會直接與 Bandwidth 合作，以利用我們的語音、全球號碼控制、緊急服務、與領先的 UCaaS 和 CCaaS 平台預建整合、容易建立的通話流程、AI 語音協調，以及其他服務，以實現他們的數位轉型。Bandwidth 提供企業一個完全或混合雲端的通訊解決方案，以從其內部通訊基礎設施轉移到軟體驅動的數位環境。
透過與 Bandwidth 合作，全球企業可以簡化其雲端遷移，以及雲端到雲端的遷移，同時減少複雜性、獲得更大的控制權、集中通訊資源及作業負載、加入新的 AI 語音服務，並更好地為未來規模做準備。我們相信 Bandwidth 作為平台領導者的歷史經驗，創造了額外的競爭優勢，例如通訊服務的深度自動化、企業級品質與支援，以及與最大 UCaaS 和 CCaaS 平台的深度作業關係。

Bandwidth MaestroTM（"Maestro"）是一個前所未有的、下一代企業雲端通訊平台，使客戶能夠解決將最佳級、即時語音應用程式整合至其 UCaaS、CCaaS、AI 和詐欺防範平台的關鍵挑戰。我們相信 Maestro 的開放方法，設計用以整合第三方開發的技術，是雲端通訊領域中獨一無二的。它提供企業所需的重要技術橋樑及軟體協調層，以在不進行複雜且昂貴整合的情況下建立現代客戶體驗堆疊，這會導致更快的價值實現，並提升客戶與員工的體驗與忠誠度。
我們的 Maestro 平台是 Bandwidth AI 創新策略的關鍵。我們相信它是企業整合對話式 AI 至雲端通訊最開放且靈活的解決方案，透過 CCaaS 平台內的原生 AI、預建合作夥伴整合、Bring Your Own AI 與第三方應用，以及如 OpenAI 的 Realtime 接口等公開 API。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析，應與我們合併財務報表及其相關附註一併閱讀，這些財務報表及附註包含於本年度報表 10-K 的其他部分。此討論包含基於目前計畫、預期與信念的向前看陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與這些向前看陳述中預期的有重大差異，原因包括但不限於本年度報表 10-K 中「風險因素」部分所列的各項因素。我們的會計年度於 12 月 31 日結束。
本項目一般討論 2025 年與 2024 年的項目及 2025 年與 2024 年的年對年比較。2023 年的項目及 2024 年與 2023 年的年對年比較未包含在內，可於我們 2024 年會計年度終了於 12 月 31 日的年度報表 10-K 中，Part II, Item 7 的「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析」中找到，該報表於 2025 年 2 月 20 日提交至 SEC。

全球通訊轉型正在進行中，我們認為 Bandwidth 站在中心位置。我們的使命是開發並提供通訊的動力。我們協助創新組織—from 新興應用開發者到全球最大企業—to 與其終端用戶互動並在人們居住、學習、工作與娛樂的地方提供卓越的體驗。透過 Bandwidth 通訊雲，我們的全球自有運營網路橫跨超過 65 個國家，覆蓋全球 GDP 的 90% 以上，創新企業使用 Bandwidth 的 API 來輕鬆嵌入語音、訊息、緊急服務與 AI 功能至軟體與應用程式。Bandwidth 是第一家在自家雲端平台提供強大 API 選項的雲端通訊供應商。我們獲獎的支援團隊協助全球企業每日轉型其通訊系統。

Bandwidth 在企業通訊與 AI 的交會點上具有戰略優勢。隨著全球企業採用 AI 驅動工具來現代化客戶體驗，我們認為 AI 音訊將成為價值創造的重要新層面。我們的 Maestro™ 平台與通訊雲端設計用以支持此演進，使 AI 音訊代理能在多樣環境中進行協調，並具備優越的品質、可靠性與規模。我們認為在 AI 音訊領域的興起領導地位是我們長期策略的自然延伸，即為全球最大企業提供值得信賴的關鍵通訊服務。
Bandwidth 的業務持續受益於 AI 技術應用於雲端通訊用例、企業遷移至雲端、採用 CCaaS 平台、能從任何地方工作的需求、客戶體驗的重新定義，以及用於直接與消費者互動的訊息應用程式成長。我們認為這些市場趨勢是長期、持續的，且目前仍處於採用曲線的早期階段。

透過我們的軟體 API、全球通訊雲端、AI 協調能力，以及我們對全球監管框架的廣泛經驗，我們認為 Bandwidth 是我們這個領域中最具優勢的供應商之一，能為全球企業提供關鍵通訊服務。事實上，Bandwidth 已經為 2025 年 GartnerⓇ Magic Quadrant Leaders 提供服務，在 UCaaS 與 CCaaS 等關鍵雲端通訊類別中，同時也為領先的超規模雲端供應商與 SaaS 平台提供服務。

我們的目標是成為 AI 時代通訊轉型的關鍵啟動平台。我們將透過以下三種方式達成此目標：(1) 向現有客戶跨銷售與升級銷售，因他們能從我們的全球佈局、強大 API 與 AI 協調能力中受益，以自動化與擴展雲端通訊；(2) 聚焦直接對企業的成長，服務直接使用 Bandwidth 服務加速其數位轉型的全球 2000 大企業；(3) 成為企業與 SaaS 平台的首選供應商，這些企業與平台使用對話式語音與訊息來創造數位互動，以提升客戶體驗。這三種策略是我們追求建立的永續業務的基礎。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日止，總營收為 754 百萬美元、748 百萬美元及 601 百萬美元，分別代表 2025 年成長 1% 及 2024 年成長 25%。2025 年、2024 年及 2023 年的淨虧損為 13 百萬美元、7 百萬美元及 16 百萬美元，分別。
2025年2月，我們與少數持有2026年可轉換票據（"2025年回購"）的持有人簽訂了單獨的私下協議，以約27百萬美元的總本金金額回購2026年可轉換票據，總現金價格為約26百萬美元。2025年回購於2025年2月24日完成。在2025年回購及先前回購2026年可轉換票據後，約8百萬美元總本金金額的2026年可轉換票據仍為未償還。
用於2025年回購的對價與2026年可轉換票據帳面價值之間的差額，導致在2025年12月31日結止年度的合併營運損益表中，記錄了1百萬美元的淨債務消滅收益。
我們監測以下關鍵績效指標，以協助我們評估業務、識別影響業務的趨勢、擬定業務計畫，並做出戰略決策。
我們認為淨留存率有助於評估我們的業務。在2025年12月31日結止年度、2024年及2023年，我們的淨留存率分別為98%、122%及101%。2024年的淨留存率受益於2024年11月美國總統選舉所驅動的更高政治宣傳收入。2023年及2025年的較低淨留存率，主要是由於2022年及2024年美國選舉週期結束後政治宣傳收入減少所致。

我們推動成長並產生額外收入的能力，在一定程度上取決於我們維持並擴大現有客戶關係的能力，這些客戶產生收入，並尋求增加他們對我們平台的使用。我們透過測量產生收入的客戶的淨留存率來追蹤此領域的表現。計算淨留存率時，我們首先確定在前一年相同季度產生收入的客戶羣組。淨留存率是透過將該羣組在當季產生的收入，除以該羣組在前一年相同季度產生的收入來計算。當季的淨留存率則透過將該季的結果與前三個季度的對應結果平均計算得出。收購業務的客戶會包含在取得後的下一年度財曆季度中。當這些客戶增加產品使用、將產品使用擴展至新應用或採用新產品時，我們的淨留存率會提高。當這些客戶停止或減少產品使用，或我們降低解決方案的價格時，我們的淨留存率會下降。
隨著客戶擴大業務並增加對我們平台的使用，他們有時會因運營或其他原因在我們這裡建立多個客戶帳戶。因此，當我們識別出一個重要的客戶組織（定義為在季度報告期間產生超過1%收入的單一客戶組織）已建立新客戶時，這個新客戶會與原始客戶綁定，且該新客戶的收入會與原始客戶的收入合併計算，以計算此指標。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們幾乎所有的營運現金均存放於各金融機構的存款帳戶中，且未經FDIC保險。
政府停擺或政府機構運作延宕，包括美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）等，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
我們所參與的市場競爭激烈，若我們無法有效競爭，可能會對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
若我們無法以成本效益的方式吸引新客戶，可能會對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
我們部分服務所處的市場尚屬新興且未經驗，可能出現衰退或成長有限的情況，且部分依賴企業與開發者持續採用我們的平台並使用我們的服務。
我們實現營收成長、現金流及營運表現的能力，取決於維持客戶並提高其使用我們服務的程度。
若我們無法提高來自企業的營收，可能會對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
我們的計費與 billing 系統相當複雜，錯誤可能會對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
我們必須持續發展有效的業務支援系統，以執行客戶訂單，並為客戶提供及計費相關服務。
若我們無法維持並提升品牌聲譽，並增加本公司與服務的市場認知度，則可能對我們的業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
我們的業務為國際性，這使我們面臨的風險較僅在國內營運的公司為之更多。
我們營收的相當大一部分集中於極少數的大型客戶。
我們目前正涉及與提供 911 服務相關稅務與費用的訴訟，這可能會分散管理階層的注意力，並對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
我們也面臨因業務運作而產生的訴訟，未投保的判決或保險費率上漲可能會對我們的營運成果造成不利影響。
通訊產業面臨顯著的法規不確定性，這些不確定性的解決可能會對我們的業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成損害。
paragraphs: 本公司業務所涉及的風險與不確定性說明如下。請謹慎考量下列所說明的風險與不確定性，並與本年度10-K財務報告中所有其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分，以及我們合併財務報表及相關附註，一併考量。下列所說明的風險與不確定性可能並非本公司唯一面臨的風險。若任何風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能下跌。
本公司成長與財務狀況受多項風險影響，包括資本市場的不確定性、多個地區的政治與經濟不穩定、廣泛的關稅課徵、不利的總體經濟條件、經濟衰退的擔憂、高通貨膨脹率與較高的利率。
近年來，美國的金融市場經歷了證券價格的重大波動、流動性降低與信貸可得性減少、某些投資的評級降級，以及其他投資價值下降。若資本與信貸市場持續面臨不確定性，本公司可能無法以有利條件或完全無法取得債務或權益融資，或重新融資現有債務，這可能會影響本公司執行戰略的能力，並對財務表現造成損害。目前這些情況尚未阻礙本公司取得信貸市場或融資營運，但無法保證未來金融市場與對主要經濟體信心不會惡化。

此外，本公司易受市場偏好變動或其他市場變動的影響，以及總體經濟條件的變化、成長率降低、利率與稅率及政策、通貨膨脹、美國、州政府與外國政府政策的重大變動，以及國家或地區間經濟關係惡化，包括對非本地產品或來源的負面消費者情緒。近年來，美國經歷了較高的通貨膨脹率，因此本公司可能面臨毛利率壓縮的問題。這些通貨膨脹壓力可能影響工資、必要零組件的價格與取得能力、本公司產品與服務的價格、滿足客戶需求的能力，以及毛利率與營運利潤。通貨膨脹可能進一步加劇本「風險因素」部分所討論的其他風險，例如與銷售與行銷努力相關的風險，以及本公司吸引、激勵與留住銷售、工程及其他關鍵人員的能力。若本公司無法成功管理通貨膨脹的影響，將可能對業務、營運成果、現金流與財務狀況造成不利影響。

由於美國與外國政府政策的近期變更，可能導致現有貿易協議的變更、對自由貿易的更大限制、對進口至美國商品課徵關稅或課徵關稅大幅增加，以及外國政府對美國貿易政策的負面回應，等等可能的變更。美國政府已實施或宣佈有意實施或增加關稅，目前尚不清楚美國政府或外國政府會或不會對關稅或貿易協議與政策採取什麼行動。美國與其他國家所實施或威脅實施的貿易措施，已導致全球經濟某些地區的波動與不確定性增加。本公司無法預測目前或任何未來潛在經濟波動或美國或全球經濟減速的時間、強度或持續時間。關稅增加可能對本公司所使用的關鍵網路零組件，包括光纖、電腦、軟體、傳輸電子產品與相關網路設施的費用造成不利影響。本公司可能無法以相應提高的服務價格來抵銷這些費用增加，這可能會對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。

美國與全球經濟過去曾經歷經濟衰退與經濟不穩定時期，未來亦將如此，這可能影響一般科技支出的速率。在這些時期，本公司現有與潛在客戶可能選擇不支出我們預期的金額，基於我們對所提供服務可達市場的預期。客戶也可能因經濟條件而遭遇財務困難，導致帳戶無法收回或收款週期延長。此外，不利的總體商業與經濟條件對本公司業務可能產生其他影響，包括第三方供應商或承包商的財務無力、市場信心下降、對通訊解決方案的興趣減少、可自由支配支出減少與對本公司所提供服務的需求減少，任何一種情況都可能對本公司業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成重大不利影響，並加劇本年度10-K財務報告中所包含的其他風險因素。
